confirmed_existing_parts: Chronological embedding coordinates match the example and Algorithm 2.
All 1000 length-four patterns with max_gap=10 are used.
Wishart r=11, mu=0.2 and full-vector cluster centers are retained.
Intermediate perturbed trajectories use technique 8, followed by endpoint averaging.
Gaussian standard deviation is the square root of the configured variance.
Three-point rapid-growth rejection uses predicted lookahead only.
remaining_unidentified_settings: Original German source, preprocessing, and split.
Lorenz coordinate, initial state, and exact normalization.
DBSCAN eps/min_samples, ensemble size, perturbation variance.
Separate AP tolerance, histogram/percentile choices, omitted classifier parameters.
Mapping from trajectory table labels to the exact experimental construction.

validation_experiment.raw_vectors: Section 3.2 diagnostic only, not substituted for Section 5 clustering.

test_policy: Original 901-origin controls isolate code changes. The new fixed-target experiment changes support and calibration chronology and is reported separately.

remaining_reconstruction_choices.choice: Histogram width, number of bins and percentile alpha are not specified by the paper.
The API exposes spread_threshold directly; the paper describes k_avg from validation times an unspecified factor. This operator is not among the 21 table configurations.
The paper gives incomplete rules; explicit interpretations remain documented in README and are not used as evidence of matching table rows.
Both trj/avg and trj/trjp use perturbed paths here; Section 3.5 supports this construction but the exact authors table configuration is not identified.
Standard RMSE remains conditional on accepted predictions; inferred paper precision/recall are exported separately from standard metrics.

checks: Calibration labels end before earliest forecast origin.
Out-of-test targets excluded from errors, coverage and masks.
Baseline calendar extension contains no future load observations.
Scalar/batch weights and train/predict feature subsets agree.
